title: Correctover MCP Risk Gazetteer entry schema v0.1
description: Per-server risk gazetteer entry over the frozen MCP Atlas Milestone-A baseline (42,163 servers / 229,827 tool params, 2026-10-12, SHA-256 anchored, Zenodo). Differentiator vs. letter-grade scanners (CSA RiskRubric A-F, PolicyLayer verb classes): every label carries an evidence chain pointing back to frozen baseline parameter paths and rule refs, plus a traceability block stating whether the server's decisions are runtime-verifiable under a pinned verifier. Designed to be citable by papers and by the draft-correctover-gg-mcp-parameter-risk vocabulary.

panel_week.description: Longitudinal panel anchor — weekly re-labels append, never overwrite; the panel is the citable longitudinal table.

server_id.description: Frozen baseline primary key (Atlas servers table row id).

risk_classes.description: draft-correctover-gg-mcp-parameter-risk canonical classes — the gazetteer labels ARE the vocabulary's application.

runtime_verifiable.description: Whether decisions of this server can be independently re-verified from published keys + records.

verifier_pin.description: Pinned verifier/inventory digest when receipt_compatible != none.

scene_tags_zh.description: 场景化中文标签（如 支付结算/凭证管理/命令执行/文件写入/网络请求）——中文生态可查询图鉴层。

evidence.description: Non-empty when label=true: parameter paths in the frozen baseline + vocabulary rule refs. No naked labels — an unlabeled claim is unverifiable and must be omitted.
